title: College Graduates, Cap Gown Lawn Ceremony - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot showing graduates and attendees walking across a university lawn during a commencement ceremony stamped February 1966. A young woman wears an academic cap and corsage alongside a man in a business suit and glasses, accompanied by another graduate in a black cap and gown visible to the right. The background features lush campus trees and an institutional building with a roof tower.
